contentHtml:
Andreas Skopal, CEO, Merkle MENA. Image Courtesy: Merkle MENA

Royal Air Maroc, Morocco's national carrier and one of Africa's leading airlines, has appointed

Press Release

Dubai, UAE - Merkle MENA, a dentsu company and a leading customer experience management agency, as its SEO, Content, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) partner. The appointment marks a significant step in Royal Air Maroc's commitment to strengthening its digital visibility and connecting with travellers across the Middle East, Africa, and beyond.

The partnership, awarded following a competitive pitch process, will see Merkle MENA develop and execute an integrated organic search and content strategy designed to grow Royal Air Maroc's presence across both traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms. As generative AI continues to reshape how travellers research and book flights, Merkle MENA will ensure Royal Air Maroc is optimally positioned within this rapidly evolving search landscape.

The scope of work spans technical SEO, content strategy and production, and GEO, which is now at the forfront of brand discovery through LLMs. Together, these disciplines will help Royal Air Maroc capture high-intent audiences at every stage of the travel journey, from early inspiration through to booking.

"We're excited to partner with Royal Air Maroc on a brief that sits right at the forefront of where search is heading. SEO and content remain foundational, but GEO is quickly becoming the next frontier for brands that want to stay visible as AI changes how people find and choose travel. We're looking forward to building a strategy that works across all of these dimensions."

Andreas Skopal, CEO, Merkle MENA

"Our ambition is to be the airline of choice for travellers connecting Africa with the world. Achieving that means being present and compelling wherever our customers are searching — whether that's on Google, or increasingly, in AI-powered tools. Merkle MENA demonstrated a clear understanding of this landscape and a bold vision for how we can lead it."

Saida Najioullah, VP, e-commerce

 About Merkle 

Merkle, a dentsu company, powers the experience economy. For more than 35 years, the company has put people at the heart of its approach to digital business transformation. As the only integrated experience consultancy in the world with a heritage in data science and business performance, Merkle delivers holistic, end-to-end experiences that drive growth, engagement, and loyalty. Merkle’s expertise has earned recognition as a “Leader” by top industry analyst firms, in categories such as digital transformation and commerce, experience design, engineering and technology integration, digital marketing, data science, CRM and loyalty, and customer data management. With more than 16,000 employees, Merkle operates in 30+ countries throughout the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. 

For more information, visit www.merkle.com.
